bio.text: Nik Sandman, a Libertarian, is a candidate for Nebraska's 1st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 12, 2026 Libertarian Party primary.
According to Ballotpedia, he graduated from Wauneta High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nebraska in 1979, and has worked as a farmer.
